scope: Real caller CLI with all child processes mocked; no browser/Node execution. Structurally readable synthetic PDF fixtures are permitted after the root PDF-operation marker.
baseline: Existing make_form_doc.py pure HTML/attachment behavior and legacy route; no exit-only substitute.
interface: make_form_doc.py FORM OUT --export-profile PROFILE --evidence-dir NEW_DIR; profile schema1 with node_executable, playwright_module and browser_channel msedge. Optional route rejects unsupported shots/append explicitly.
cases: Valid readable PDF: exact qualified guard receives actual child result/input/options/expected file, then local publication remains pending visual review
Nonzero child exit even with matching receipt and valid PDF
Empty child artifact with matching receipt
Matching receipt around a valid zero-page PDF
Preexisting destination remains byte-identical and child is not called
Destination appearing during child completion is preserved rather than overwritten
Preexisting evidence directory is rejected without changing its sentinel or running a child
Missing profile/evidence argument partner rejects before child execution
Optional route rejects screenshots and append explicitly
Current and legacy attachment rendering and invalid-input behavior match the baseline
Default legacy CLI still follows its established renderer/merge/readback route without opting into new evidence behavior
observations_required: Failed process/artifact/receipt/PDF paths never create or overwrite requested publication output
Invoked-child failures preserve actual raw stdout/stderr and a failure result
Every call preserves source form/profile and existing output/evidence where relevant
New route uses the fixed offline renderer and finite timeout without shell=True
Success result says published_pending_visual_review, visual_review pending and receipt_checked true
No synthetic result is counted as a fresh native render or visual acceptance
limits: Native runtime availability and fresh PDF visual inspection remain the root's separate qualification
No OS/network sandbox or race-free filesystem transaction guarantee beyond the tested exclusive destination behavior
No historical application evidence is edited, and no model or external service is called
